lines: Remove the SD card and the game cartridge from the device.

steps.title: Battery removal
lines: Locate the battery cover panel on the back of the device.
Unscrew the two screws on the battery cover panel with a Phillips #00 screwdriver.
Remove the battery and battery cover panel.
Remove the four screws on the battery panel using the Phillips #00 screwdriver.
Locate the two screw covers on the bottom of the back panel, near the middle of the device.
These sticker-like covers are small, round, and made of rubber or plastic.
Insert the tip of a flathead screwdriver or spudger and gently pry the cover off by applying upward pressure.
You may need to wiggle the tool back and forth a bit to loosen the two covers.
Remove the two screws located behind the screw covers using a Phillips #00 screwdriver.
Remove the screw near the game card compartment using a Phillips #00 screwdriver.
Lift the back panel off of the device.
Be cautious not to pull any ribbons or cables from the motherboard as you remove the back panel.
Locate and disconnect the ribbon cables from the motherboard by gently pulling on the tabs that hold them in place.
Remove the three left bumper assembly screws using Phillips #00 screwdriver.
Once the three screws are removed, gently remove the left bumper assembly from the device.
The spring may eject from the assembly as you remove it.
Remove the hinge pin from the bumper assembly.
Separate the bumper from the bumper assembly
Using a spudger or a flathead screwdriver, gently pull the ribbon cable straight out of the connector in order to remove it.
The ribbon cable can be removed by other means such as using gloves or a [product|IF145-284|microfiber cloth] if preferred.
Replace the left bumper ribbon cable.
